findings.description: `UpConn pool` is a member of each detached worker, so the victim has to meet the armed worker: 60 sequential requests produced 60 distinct sockets, 0/9 reuse even on one kept-alive connection. The replay pair leaks 10/50 with deliberate keep-alive affinity and 0/30 one-shot, so it is a negative as a steerable leak but a real latent defect: there is no peek, so a single stray byte is re-read by the next `Reader` and fails the parse rather than being discarded. `reusable` is set from the head and `rd.b.empty()` (`:99`, `:100`), and the retry asymmetry of the sibling builds also applies.
findings.title: The pool has no liveness check at all and is per-worker, so a stray upstream byte corrupts the next response parse instead of being dropped

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
